attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT callee.symbol_id AS symbol_id
FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls AS c
JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS caller
  ON c.caller_symbol_id = caller.symbol_id
JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS callee
  ON c.callee_symbol_id = callee.symbol_id
WHERE caller.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py'
  AND caller.name = 'create_graph'
  AND caller.kind = 'function'
  AND c.call_kind = 'callback'
  AND c.callee_name NOT LIKE '%.%'
  AND c.callee_name NOT LIKE '%(%'
  AND c.callee_name NOT LIKE '%lambda%'
  AND callee.kind IN ('function', 'method')
ORDER BY symbol_id;

Functions passed only inside an if/else branch of create_graph count. Return each distinct function's symbol ID.

Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. explanation: This returns the distinct symbol IDs of repository functions or methods that the create_graph function in the text-to-SQL graph module passes by reference as callback arguments. It looks at callback call records made by create_graph, keeps only plain-name arguments, and resolves each to its internal symbol definition. The results are deduplicated and ordered by symbol ID.
